name: siliconflow
description: OpenAI-compatible gateway hosting open-weight and Chinese frontier models (DeepSeek, Qwen, GLM, Kimi, Hunyuan and more), with mainland-China and international endpoints

env_vars.name: SILICONFLOW_BASE_URL
env_vars.description: SiliconFlow API base URL. Use https://api.siliconflow.cn/v1 for the mainland-China endpoint; the two sites have separate accounts and keys.

setup_steps: Sign up at https://cloud.siliconflow.com (mainland China: https://cloud.siliconflow.cn)
Create an API key (https://cloud.siliconflow.com/account/ak or https://cloud.siliconflow.cn/account/ak)
Paste the key above as SILICONFLOW_API_KEY
